newsitem.title: NORWAY: Saga's Tordis reaches peak output at 90,000 bpd.
newsitem.headline: Saga's Tordis reaches peak output at 90,000 bpd.

text.p: Crude production at the North Sea Tordis field has reached a peak level of around 90,000 barrels per day (bpd), operator Saga Petroleum ASA said on Wednesday.
Output at Tordis resumed on late on Monday following scheduled maintenance. The field was shut in on October 11 when the giant Gullfaks was closed for turnaround.
Tordis feeds crude to Gullfaks C for processing and transportation.
"All five wells were in production at 4 pm (1500 GMT) last night," said Saga spokeswoman Karin Ovsteboe. "Tordis is now producing at about 90,000 bpd."
In September Tordis pumped an average 74,047 bpd.
